item.text: {"asks":[{"quote":"Do you want Strata to normalize these, for example always showing \"Explore: search for tests\" style labels, or should it show what the provider sent?","question":"Should Strata normalize subagent labels into a consistent style, or display the labels supplied by each provider?"},{"quote":"The alternative is moving finished activity into the Trace drawer so the conversation stays clean.","question":"Should finished activity remain collapsed under the message, or move into the Trace drawer?"},{"quote":"Is eight the right number, or would you rather it show everything and scroll?","question":"Should the activity strip show at most eight rows, or show all rows with scrolling?"},{"quote":"Is that enough, or do you want the error inline?","question":"Should subagent errors remain only in the trace, or also appear inline in the activity strip?"}]}
